displayDescription.description:
Description text to render below the #displayName. This may be a string reference to a
{@link Translation#key}

displaySearchPlaceholder.description:
Text to render in the Search input as the placeholder when this tool is selected. This may be a string reference
to a {@link Translation#key}

icon.description:
The icon (from https://fontawesome.com/v6/icons/) to use. Not all icons are supported out-of-the-box, so this may
also require an update to `GenAiUiQueryToolSelectorDropdown.scss` and `GenAiUiVariables.scss`
for some icons.

title: Configuration for how a tool should be shown in the UI dropdown.
name: Genai.Agent.Tool.Config.UiOptions.Base
